fact: ATDI trained 25 technicians from nine public bodies, including civil identification, migration, tax, social action and registries, on the X-Road data-exchange layer to prepare them to integrate their institutions' systems, with World Bank EDGE support.

MISAU's SIS-MA page describes an interoperability platform, a mediating layer centralising communication between SIS-MA and other systems, with live integrations to the medicines-logistics system of CMAM (Ferramenta Central) and to the Ministry of Justice's SIRCEV for death-certificate data.
Ecofin Agency reports that ATDI is developing an interoperability platform to connect systems across government institutions, with launch planned for the fourth quarter of 2026.

ATDI's World Bank-funded (EDGE) request for expressions of interest states that ATDI has already begun implementing an X-Road-based Interoperability Platform for secure data exchange between government institutions and service providers.
ATDI is developing an interoperability platform for government that is expected to be available in the fourth quarter of 2026, so citizens give their data only once.
